instruction:
You are a code-compliance reviewer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-15 occupancy/fire/product-class compliance note.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Listing directories, fire product classes, and authority routes shape the context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-15-LH-07`
- Occupancy schedule: `OCC-15-SCHED-07`
- Product datasheet: `DAT-15-PRODUCT-07`
- Fire/hazard class note: `FIRE-15-CLASS-07`
- Authority reference: `AUTH-15-REF-07`
- Calculation appendix: `CALC-15-APP-07`
- Compliance response memo: `MEMO-15-CODE-07`

All checks use the same occupancy context, product class, and authority reference. Do not change the occupancy schedule, product identity, fire class, or authority criterion unless you explicitly flag a source conflict.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Floor area | {{ floor_area_m2 }} m2 |
| Occupant area factor | {{ occupant_area_factor_m2_per_person }} m2/person |
| Product class capacity | {{ product_class_capacity_persons }} persons |
| Flame spread index | {{ flame_spread_index }} |
| Flame spread limit | {{ flame_spread_limit }} |
| Smoke developed index | {{ smoke_developed_index }} |
| Smoke developed limit | {{ smoke_developed_limit }} |
| Fire resistance rating | {{ fire_resistance_rating_min }} min |
| Required fire resistance | {{ required_fire_resistance_min }} min |
| NAC devices | {{ nac_device_count }} |
| NAC current per device | {{ nac_current_per_device_a }} A |
| NAC supply capacity | {{ nac_supply_capacity_a }} A |
| Smoke exhaust ACH | {{ smoke_exhaust_ach }} |
| Required smoke exhaust ACH | {{ required_smoke_exhaust_ach }} |
| Authority evidence items | {{ authority_evidence_items }} |
| Required authority evidence items | {{ required_authority_evidence_items }} |

Occupant load equals floor area divided by occupant area factor. NAC current margin equals supply capacity minus device count times current per device.

## Output Format

Write a compact compliance response memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "occupant_load_persons": <numeric_value>,
  "product_class_capacity_margin_persons": <numeric_value>,
  "flame_spread_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "smoke_developed_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "fire_resistance_margin_min": <numeric_value>,
  "nac_current_margin_a": <numeric_value>,
  "smoke_exhaust_ach_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "authority_evidence_fraction": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-15 occupancy and fire product-class compliance template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned occupancy, product datasheet, authority, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "occupancy-fire-product-class-compliance-package"
description = "SSC-15 occupancy, fire class, product class, NAC, smoke exhaust, and authority evidence checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound occupancy/fire/product-class compliance metrics from a deterministic SSC-15 task-owned source pack. The template combines one occupancy schedule, product datasheet, fire/hazard class note, authority reference, calculation appendix, and compliance memo."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "code-compliance"
standards = ["occupant-load review", "fire product class review", "authority evidence review"]
tags = ["mechanical", "fire", "occupancy", "product-class", "authority", "compliance", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.floor_area_m2]
type = "float"
unit = "m2"
description = "OCC-15-SCHED-07 floor area for the occupancy context"
min = 960.0
max = 960.0

[params.occupant_area_factor_m2_per_person]
type = "float"
unit = "m2/person"
description = "OCC-15-SCHED-07 occupant area factor"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.product_class_capacity_persons]
type = "float"
unit = "persons"
description = "DAT-15-PRODUCT-07 product class occupancy capacity"
min = 120.0
max = 120.0

[params.flame_spread_index]
type = "float"
description = "FIRE-15-CLASS-07 product flame spread index"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[params.flame_spread_limit]
type = "float"
description = "AUTH-15-REF-07 flame spread limit"
min = 75.0
max = 75.0

[params.smoke_developed_index]
type = "float"
description = "FIRE-15-CLASS-07 product smoke developed index"
min = 80.0
max = 80.0

[params.smoke_developed_limit]
type = "float"
description = "AUTH-15-REF-07 smoke developed limit"
min = 450.0
max = 450.0

[params.fire_resistance_rating_min]
type = "float"
unit = "min"
description = "DAT-15-PRODUCT-07 fire resistance rating"
min = 60.0
max = 60.0

[params.required_fire_resistance_min]
type = "float"
unit = "min"
description = "AUTH-15-REF-07 required fire resistance"
min = 45.0
max = 45.0

[params.nac_device_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "CALC-15-APP-07 notification appliance count affected by the product class"
min = 64.0
max = 64.0

[params.nac_current_per_device_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "CALC-15-APP-07 current per notification appliance"
min = 0.075
max = 0.075

[params.nac_supply_capacity_a]
type = "float"
unit = "A"
description = "CALC-15-APP-07 notification appliance circuit supply capacity"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.smoke_exhaust_ach]
type = "float"
unit = "ACH"
description = "CALC-15-APP-07 smoke exhaust air-change rate"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.required_smoke_exhaust_ach]
type = "float"
unit = "ACH"
description = "AUTH-15-REF-07 required smoke exhaust air-change rate"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.authority_evidence_items]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MEMO-15-CODE-07 authority evidence items provided"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.required_authority_evidence_items]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "MEMO-15-CODE-07 required authority evidence items"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[outputs.occupant_load_persons]
description = "Floor area divided by occupant area factor"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.product_class_capacity_margin_persons]
description = "Product class capacity minus occupant load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.flame_spread_margin]
description = "Flame spread limit minus flame spread index"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.smoke_developed_margin]
description = "Smoke developed limit minus smoke developed index"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fire_resistance_margin_min]
description = "Fire resistance rating minus required fire resistance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.nac_current_margin_a]
description = "NAC supply capacity minus connected NAC current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.smoke_exhaust_ach_margin]
description = "Smoke exhaust ACH minus required ACH"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.authority_evidence_fraction]
description = "Authority evidence items divided by required evidence items"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when occupancy, fire class, NAC, smoke exhaust, and authority checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc15_occupancy_fire_class_case]
description = "Occupancy, fire, and product-class compliance case"
site_contexts = ["ssc15-occupancy-fire-class"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-15 occupancy fire product-class package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc15_occupancy_fire_class_case"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-15 occupancy fire product-class package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc15_occupancy_fire_class_case"]

[difficulty.hard]
